transcript.text: microwve plate wont go round anymore, food hot on one side cold on other. still heats tho

If the turntable has stopped rotating, food will heat unevenly because one side gets all the microwave energy while the other stays cold. The most likely causes are that the glass plate isn't sitting correctly on its drive coupler, something is catching against it, or the plastic coupler itself (or the roller ring underneath) has broken. Please unplug the appliance for safety, lift out the glass tray, and check that the small three-pronged plastic piece in the centre isn't cracked and that the tray sits flat on it without touching the sides.
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
ok took the plate out. the little 3 pronged plastic bit in the middle has a crack in it and the hole in the middle looks rounded. plate sits on it but wobbles

The cracked and rounded plastic piece you found is the turntable coupler. It can no longer grip the glass plate to make it rotate, which explains why your food heats unevenly. This is a common wear part that simply needs replacing; the microwave itself is likely fine. Once you fit the new plastic piece and refit the glass plate, the rotation should work normally again.
[Safety panel] Don't remove the microwave's casing or try to repair it inside. Parts inside a microwave can hold a dangerous electric charge even after it's unplugged — have it checked by a qualified engineer.
